messages:
maria: Heads-up — pricing change going to prod next week. Need to confirm who owns the metering adapter changes for contract-level quota caps. Will billing pipeline enforce, or do we short-circuit at ingest? @devon @sasha

devon: I can take the metering adapter PRs. Quick Q: do contract caps apply per-customer across Dedicated/Hosted?

sasha: They're contract-scoped (not per-deployment). Billing will reconcile at invoice time, but enforcement at ingest prevents overage token counting. We need both: real-time quota for customer-facing signals + billing reconciliation.

liam: +1. From infra side, we can expose a `quota_check` hook in the adapter. Example config:

```
adapter:
  quota_hook: /internal/quota/check
  scope: contract_id
```

maria: Thanks. Is there a documented contract field we can use? Contracts service exposes `contract_id` and `plan_sla`. Any other constraints (ratelimit vs token quota)?

prashant: Contracts have `quota_limit_tokens` and `quota_window_days`. Also `billing_mode` (prepaid|postpay). For prepaid, we should reject at ingest; for postpay, mark usage and allow but flag.

elaine: From billing side: for postpay we need opaque metering events with `contract_id`, `usage_type=token`, `usage_value`, `timestamp`. Prefer minimal enrichment in adapter; keep heavy enrichment in billing sdk.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled — pipeline/ci #3456 started for `metering-adapter` (build 2026.03.16-12). Link: https://ci.redwood.example/3456

devon: @elaine noted: we'll emit events to `metering.ingest` Kafka topic with schema v2 (see spec). I'll attach PR to repo. ETA EOD tomorrow for PR, rollout next Wed canary.

maria: Action items: 1) @devon implement `quota_check` hook + emit v2 events; 2) @sasha add adapter config and tests; 3) @elaine align billing ingest schema + reconciliation rules; 4) @liam validate perf on canary. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:

prashant: I'll open a short runbook for prepaid enforcement & invoice edgecases.

maria: Great — if no objections I'll mark owners in the ticket and add a dependency to the release notes.
